summaries.golang-cibc: Accomplished GoLang Developer with 3.5+ years building RESTful microservices in Go, with hands-on Azure Cloud experience, event-driven pipelines, and CI/CD automation. Core contributor to four open-source products at Turbot (120+ merged PRs, 9,300+ GitHub stars) — built a Go/Gin REST microservice and cut resource-discovery latency 70–90% via an Azure-based migration.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and built an internal RESTful API microservice in Go using the Gin framework for a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Authored multi-cloud compliance modules in HCL + SQL covering 1,000+ resource checks across CIS, NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4, SOC 2, and FedRAMP frameworks — used by enterprise customers in finance, healthcare, and government — cutting enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, and deployment; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring Azure API throttling.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook on success; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures, hardening reliability.

Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs — unified GitHub Actions CI/CD release workflows and automated Docker image tagging; core contributor with 120+ merged PRs and 9,300+ GitHub stars.
Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents real-time access to enterprise cloud data — hands-on agentic AI and automation experience.

projects.name: Lila Tic-Tac-Toe — Real-Time Multiplayer Game
projects.description: Full-stack real-time multiplayer game built end to end in 4 days: a Go-based Nakama game server on Fly.io with PostgreSQL, React 19 + TypeScript front-end on Vercel. Server-authoritative anti-cheat over WebSocket, mode-aware matchmaking, optimistic UI, a top-10 leaderboard, and reconnect-into-active-match.

projects.name: CIS Benchmark → Compliance Dashboard Generator
projects.description: Python CLI automating compliance-dashboard authoring for a multi-cloud governance product. Ingests CIS benchmark XLSX workbooks (AWS, Azure) and emits ready-to-deploy HCL dashboard config plus markdown docs; OOP resource model, custom HCL pretty-printer.
